- **Packet:** `repository-step-18-dev-up-reset` — Add deterministic local PostgreSQL dev-up and dev-reset

## Objective

Continue Repository Step 18 with deterministic, cross-platform `dev-up` and `dev-reset` commands for the local PostgreSQL dependency plane. Use an immutable production-aligned PostgreSQL 17 image, checkout-scoped owned Docker resources, loopback-only publishing, repository migrations and accepted fixtures, schema-drift detection, idempotent reuse and fail-closed reset semantics while leaving demo seeding, backend/frontend orchestration and smoke acceptance for later bounded Step 18 packets.

## Deliverables

- `add repo.py dev-up with deterministic human and JSON reports plus a side-effect-free dry-run`
- `pin the local PostgreSQL dependency to an immutable official PostgreSQL 17 Alpine multi-platform image digest`
- `derive checkout-scoped container and volume names from a validated namespace and attach immutable ownership labels`
- `publish PostgreSQL only on 127.0.0.1 with a validated configurable local port`
- `initialize the database through Docker-native psql using every ordered committed migration and the accepted platform fixtures`
- `record and verify a deterministic schema-input digest before reusing local state`
- `add repo.py dev-reset that refuses foreign resources, removes only exactly owned container and volume state, and recreates a clean ready dependency plane`
- `prove create, idempotent reuse, drift refusal, foreign-resource refusal, reset and clean-environment behavior through permanent unit and Docker acceptance`
- `document only dev-up/dev-reset as implemented while keeping seed-demo, smoke and Step 19 explicitly open`

## Acceptance

- the branch is based exactly on main commit dbb3e08097ff9439161ce94ff91b8912c8a0b249 and contains only the declared dev-up/dev-reset packet files
- dev-up uses the full doctor prerequisite profile and never silently installs, upgrades or globally switches Docker or toolchains
- the PostgreSQL image reference contains both a production-aligned PostgreSQL 17 Alpine tag and an immutable sha256 digest
- resource names and labels are deterministic for one checkout or an explicit validated namespace
- dev-up binds only 127.0.0.1, rejects invalid ports, and refuses incomplete, foreign, image-drifted, configuration-drifted or schema-drifted resources
- fresh initialization applies all sorted up migrations and the accepted platform, sales-activities and search-role fixtures through Docker-native psql with ON_ERROR_STOP
- a second unchanged dev-up reuses the exact owned ready database without reapplying migrations
- dev-reset dry-run mutates nothing; real reset verifies ownership before removing the container and volume and recreates a clean ready database
- a permanent clean-environment Docker acceptance proves first up, idempotent second up, destructive reset and absence of a pre-reset probe after recreation
- future changes to repository lifecycle entry points select Governance CI and run both focused unit and Docker acceptance
- documentation does not claim seed-demo, smoke, Repository Step 18, Phase 8A or architecture 10/10 complete
- one unchanged meaningful final head passes every applicable permanent workflow with zero unresolved comments or review threads
